declarations.type:
∀ (cached current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey),
  SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse cached current = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.reuse ↔
    cached = current
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.semantic_reuse_iff_exact_key

declarations.type:
∀ (cached current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey),
  cached ≠ current →
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse cached current = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.invalidate
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.semantic_key_drift_invalidates

declarations.type:
SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitProvider SearchLoopCacheIdentity.baseSemanticKey =
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitProvider SearchLoopCacheIdentity.providerDriftKey ∧
  SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse SearchLoopCacheIdentity.baseSemanticKey
      SearchLoopCacheIdentity.providerDriftKey =
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.invalidate
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitting_provider_allows_false_reuse

declarations.type:
SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitPolicy SearchLoopCacheIdentity.baseSemanticKey =
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitPolicy SearchLoopCacheIdentity.policyDriftKey ∧
  SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse SearchLoopCacheIdentity.baseSemanticKey
      SearchLoopCacheIdentity.policyDriftKey =
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.invalidate
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitting_policy_allows_false_reuse

declarations.type:
SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitRfc SearchLoopCacheIdentity.baseSemanticKey =
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitRfc SearchLoopCacheIdentity.rfcDriftKey ∧
  SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse SearchLoopCacheIdentity.baseSemanticKey
      SearchLoopCacheIdentity.rfcDriftKey =
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.invalidate
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.omitting_rfc_allows_false_reuse

declarations.type:
∀ (current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey) (entry : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheEntry),
  entry.key ≠ current →
    (SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconcile current entry).state = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.EntryState.stale
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconcile_drift_is_stale

declarations.type:
∀ (current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey) (entry : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheEntry),
  (SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconcile current entry).state = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.EntryState.valid →
    entry.key = current
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconciled_valid_implies_exact_key
